sourceChanges.citationTitle: AI Research and Innovation Hub Terms & Conditions
Instructions on The Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools at Qatar University

claimChanges.claimText: Gemini Enterprise is listed for Qatar University in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

For Qatar University AI Research and Innovation Hub resources, the terms state that requested resources are for specified research projects, required IRB or ethics approvals must be obtained before use, and project data must follow Qatar University data protection, privacy, research governance, IT security, acceptable-use, and data-handling policies.

Qatar University instructs users to review generative AI outputs for accuracy, validity, bias, and appropriateness before use or publication, while remaining fully responsible for content produced or used with AI assistance.
Qatar University instructs users to avoid entering personal, confidential, and sensitive data into AI tools or platforms.
Qatar University instructs users to refrain from relying on generative AI to write research papers, assignments, or theses on behalf of students or researchers.
Qatar University instructs users to disclose any generative AI use in academic, research, or administrative outputs and to clarify its scope and extent, including contribution level.

Qatar University's generative AI instructions apply to university affiliates across teaching, research, administrative work, technical services, student services, and other uses within the university's scope or name.
